What is actually happening?

Each logical worker owns a fresh, independently adapting Ripple Neuron. A red input of 0.35 while its queue is nonempty excites the original integrator. Its firing event permits one integer reduction; the master verifies and assembles all pieces.

New clones receive part of their parent's queue. Work stealing moves a task one link at a time, never copies an unfinished task. Retirement transfers queued work first.
